name: Pedro_RKO & Mr.Xtreme Hardcore
notes: Won the FDW Tag Team Championship from Lord and Rated R in the promotion's own first Crush! show; Pedro_RKO turned on his own partner mid-match to win it, an early sign of the fed's own long-running swerve culture.
caption: Crush!'s own first FDW Tag Team Champions, crowned when Pedro_RKO turned on his own partner to win.

name: Lord & Rated R
notes: Lost the FDW Tag Team Championship match to Pedro_RKO and Mr.Xtreme Hardcore in the promotion's own first Crush! show.
caption: A pairing that lost Crush!'s own first FDW Tag Team Championship match.

name: Kajo & Spartan
notes: Won the Sacrifice Tag Team Championship over Manu Original Punk and Great One in the brand's own first show, Spartan pinning Great One after a Go To Sleep.
caption: Sacrifice's own first Tag Team Champions.

name: Manu Original Punk & Great One
notes: Lost the Sacrifice Tag Team Championship match to Kajo and Spartan in the brand's own first show.
caption: A pairing that lost Sacrifice's own first Tag Team Championship match.
